mentions.name: Julia language support for Godot
mentions.description: This project adds Julia language support to the Godot game engine, so the native Godot application can call a Julia shared object. Work is resuming after a delay caused by a failed power supply.
mentions.problem: Debugging has been a challenge: the native Godot application calls the Julia shared object, and the author hasn't figured out how to get the Julia debugger to catch exceptions.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding Julia language support to Godot.  Delayed by a failed power supply, but starting back at it.  Debugging has been a challenge since the native godot application is calling the julia shared object and I haven't figured out how to get the julia debugger to catch exceptions.
